value.title: L'inchino della cavalletta
value.synopsis: When Nobi gets blamed for things he had not done, Doraemon creates an apology device resembling grasshoppers.

value.title: Il dinosauro
value.synopsis: Doraemon gives Nobita a giant paper cut-out book which makes things that really work like a flying saucer, and a dinosaur which wants to eat them.

value.title: Bella come un mughetto
value.synopsis: Nobita's father tells him that he had received chocolate from a girl when he was a child, so Nobita and Doraemon go to the past to find out who the girl was. Nobita falls into a pond and gets wet, and Doraemon gives him a piece of cloth to wear which makes him look like a girl. They spot Nobita's father coming to the edge of the pond, and Doraemon gives Nobita chocolate which he gives to his father.

value.title: Detective fotografico
value.synopsis: Mr. Nobi, Nobita's father has lost his wallet so using a camera which can photograph past events, Nobita and Doraemon track it down.

value.title: Il robot sosia
value.synopsis: The episode begins with Nobita's mother preparing a fine meal in celebration of the twelfth anniversary of Nobita's father and hers wedding. At dinner, Nobita's mother and father have conflicting memories on who proposed first.

value.title: Prenotazioni meccaniche
value.synopsis: Doraemon helps Nobita and his father see a new film using a machine which can reserve anything so no one else can use that thing first. Nobita inadvertently traps 3 of his friends at home all afternoon and Gian promises revenge.

value.title: Il procione
value.synopsis: After Suneo upsets Nobita by saying he looks like a cartoon raccoon, Doraemon gives Nobita glasses which makes Suneo see the illusions that he wants him to see, and so upsets Shizuka and Gian.

value.title: Il quaderno magico
value.synopsis: Shizuka agrees to study with Nobita but when Gian asks her, she goes with him instead. Cry baby Nobita moans to Doraemon who gives him a pad where anything he writes in it comes true.

value.title: La ragazza con le scarpe rosse
value.synopsis: Nobita is forced to clean the shed with his mom and get rid of some old things he no longer needs. A red shoe appears and turns out to be the shoe of a girl that used to be in his neighborhood, but moved to America. Nobita and her used to be next door neighbors and have play dates all afternoon. Little Suneo and Gian made fun of little Nobita and made him steal one of her shoe the day prior to her family moving. Nobita remembering the events asked Doraemon to go back to the past with him to correct his wrongs. Nobita returns her shoe, apologizes, and makes a promise to find her in America when they grow up. In return she gives Nobita all of the pots and pans they used while playing house. Remade in 1987 as "Memories of the Red Shoe."

value.title: Il rossetto
value.synopsis: Nobita's too honest comments upsets his parents so Doraemon gives him a lipstick which makes him charm everybody. His mother finds a discarded lipstick which makes wearers insult everybody and Nobita comes home to find her and his father shouting insults at each other.

value.title: I ricordi della nonna (1)
value.synopsis: Looking through some old photos, Nobita is very upset as he misses his (dead) grandmother who made a lot of fuss over him. Against his will Doraemon takes them back 8 years. Nobita upsets his mother who does not recognize him as her 3 -year-old son. This episode is later remade in 1986 as "I Love Grandma."

value.title: Che amore di nonna (2)
value.synopsis: Nobita gets to meet his grandmother and finds he was a bit of a bratty kid. Again upsetting his then mother and self, his grandmother protects him again and he shows her what he looks like in his school uniform before leaving.

value.title: L'insegnante
value.synopsis: Nobita's parents decide to get him a tutor as his grades are bad so Nobita decides to use himself 3 years in the future to answer his school questions now. But his future self is dumb because Nobita did not study and that Nobita too has a future self who turns up and complains that he is dumb too because Nobita 3 years in the future did not study either. The three of them go to the kindergarten Nobita, saying that if they want to improve their grades,they have to start from the beginning. However none of them has the heart to tell the kindergarten Nobita to study, so they return to the present time.

value.title: Incontri ravvicinati
value.synopsis: Despite being told not to, Nobita plays with Doraemon's machine, finding it calls a UFO from far away. The alien is upset, being called for no good reason but they manage to placate it with beer. Nobita's mother upsets it and it wants to invade the Earth but is again placated by Nobita's marble collection.

value.title: Lo specchio magico
value.synopsis: Nobita wants many toys but can't afford them. Using Doraemon's magic mirror, what he holds up to it is copied, so he borrows toys and copies them. But Nobita also gets copied himself producing a mischievous Nobita.

value.title: La carta copiatrice
value.synopsis: Nobita cannot go out so Doraemon produces some magic paper that makes paper copies of anything including Nobita. However, as soon as they leave, a wind blows away the paper figure of Nobita which then has a number of adventures. Remade as The Nobita that Nobita Never Knew in the 2005 series.

value.title: Il sottomarino
value.synopsis: Doraemon produces a mini submarine which makes many jumps into all sorts of liquids including a toilet bowl on its way to the sea.

value.title: La capsula dell'amicizia
value.synopsis: Suneo tries to lure Doraemon from Nobita but he won't go so he gives Suneo a capsule which makes anyone your friend as a consolation. Cunning Suneo uses it to make Doraemon become his friend.

value.title: Il cerchietto della volontà
value.synopsis: Nobita is too lazy to do his homework without pressure so Doraemon gives him a headband which is painful if anyone says "close", which Doraemon uses to make Nobita do what he should do.

value.title: L'albero appartamento
value.synopsis: Nobita wants his own apartment so Doraemon gives him a tree which grows rooms underground and the gang move in. Remade in 1989 as "Apartment Pretend."

value.title: Caccia al colpevole
value.synopsis: Nobita is wrongly blamed for breaking a school window. A time machine helps him find out what really happened.

value.title: Duelli con la pistola
value.synopsis: Doraemon gives Nobita an ointment which when rubbed on the fingers, fires a jet of air powerful enough to knock someone over. Remade as "Air Pistol" in 2001.

value.title: La scatola delle multe
value.synopsis: Gian busts another football so all the gang say they have no money for another one. Doraemon produces a small robot which takes 100 yen from anyone who does something bad, to get money for a new ball. Bully Gian quickly falls foul of it.

value.title: L'isola deserta
value.synopsis: Nobita wants to live on an island like Robinson Crusoe, but is such a helpless crybaby that hidden Doraemon has to keep helping him.

value.title: Mattoni d'aria
value.synopsis: Doraemon gives Nobita a machine which produces blocks of solid air which stay in position. Unfortunately he forgets to tell Nobita that they vanish after a time, leaving him hanging high up in the air.

value.title: Lo spray magico
value.synopsis: Doraemon gives Nobita a spray that changes a picture to what would happen next in the picture, like a ship moving. Nobita ruins a man's art collection trying it out.

value.title: Oggetti smarriti
value.synopsis: Nobita tells Doraemon that he lost his grandmother's platinum ring. Doraemon helps him using a Lost Item Retrieval Machine.

value.title: L'antenna
value.synopsis: Doraemon and Nobita use a TV antenna, which allows the wearer to be prepared for any event that will happen.

value.title: La voce
value.synopsis: Gian is giving Nobita trouble so Doraemon gives him a medicine which makes his words into solid letters which can be used as weapons.

value.title: La stella dei desideri
value.synopsis: Doraemon throws out some of his useless inventions, including the Star of Hope. Gian and Suneo find it, not realizing that the wishes it grants are always wrong. Remade in 1992 as "Ask the Stars."

value.title: La grande battaglia
value.synopsis: Doraemon helps Nobita win an R/C battle in the waters.

value.title: Una nuova macchina fotografica
value.synopsis: A special camera can see through things including clothing. Not knowing this, Shizuka wants Nobita to take a picture of her. Some nudity occurs.

value.title: Paura dei lampi
value.synopsis: Doraemon produces a small thunder cloud to cure Nobita of his fear of thunder. This done, Nobita uses it to shock people.

value.title: L'uomo del futuro
value.synopsis: Nobita tries to get the better of bully Gian using Doraemon's things from the future, but Gian has things from the future too and gets the better of him.

value.title: Previsioni del tempo
value.synopsis: After Suneo and Nobita argue about the weather of the next day, Doraemon gives him a gadget that controls the weather.

value.title: Il bambino prodigio
value.synopsis: Doraemon gives Nobita the Do-Over Machine which lets the user redo any age. This episode was later remade in 1994 as "Redo Life Machine," then as "The Life Do-Over Machine" in the 2005 series.

value.title: Bugie e verità
value.synopsis: Using a Lying Beak, Nobita makes the lies about his father true.

value.title: Una piccola robot innamorata
value.synopsis: Nobita is doing poorly with girls so Doraemon makes him a girl to love him but the powerful machine gets jealous of Shizuka and angry when Nobita's mother shouts at him.

value.title: Le nuvole
value.synopsis: Nobita is working on his tan when a cloud covers the sun. Doraemon gives him a machine which controls clouds and he uses it to scare Shizuka and a friend as well as Gian. Then it overheats.

value.title: La primavera
value.synopsis: Suneo butters up everybody, to Nobita's annoyance so Doraemon gives him a square of sellotape which when put on Suneo's back reveals his true bad personality to everyone.

value.title: L'extraterrestre
value.synopsis: Gian and Suneo trick Nobita with a fake UFO, so Doraemon comes up with a real one and a remote controlled alien, then makes the pair regret their joke.

value.title: Il libro vivente
value.synopsis: Doraemon gives Nobita an illustrated encyclopedia from the future. When he turns to the page of the thing he wants to look up, then hits the spine of the book, the real thing will come flying out.

value.title: La macchina fotografica per belli
value.synopsis: A rope that can bring anything falls into Suneo's hands and he uses it to take stuff from the other kids, then Nobita gets the blame but a good deed reveals the true villain.

value.title: Il giorno della mia nascita
value.synopsis: The episode begins with Nobita getting yelled at by his mom and dad. Their expectations and reality causes Nobita to believe that he was picked up or adopted. Nobita and Doraemon go back to the past to the day that Nobita was born. Nobita realizes the dreams and aspirations that his parents hold for him and it causes him to study.

value.title: La fabbrica degli incidenti
value.synopsis: น้ำยาสลับชายหญิง Nobita's father moans at him because he doesn't like boy's games. Doraemon uses a spray which makes boys behave like girls and girls behave like boys. Nobita doesn't like the result and even less when he finds it has affected his parents too.

value.title: Una piscina fra le nuvole
value.synopsis: The episode starts off with Suneo and Gian asking Nobita if he wants to go to the pool. Nobita runs away and is questioned by Doraemon. Nobita reveals that he can't swim and that they were just mocking him. Doraemon seeing that Nobita is embarrassed to go to the community pool decided to create a pool for Nobita in the sky. Along the way, Suneo, Gian, and Shizuka tag along.

value.title: L’arco e la freccia
value.synopsis: With a Moving Arrow and Bow, Doraemon helps Nobita place targets at various locations so going around would be a breeze. Gian and Suneo steal an arrow from Doraemon and Nobita, but a dog moves the destination target to a canal causing them to fall into it.

value.title: La casa delle lumache
value.synopsis: Nobita gets called a liar by his mom when she believes him to be hiding his recent exam. Nobita complains to Doraemon and exchanges his snacks for a snail shell that protects him from his surroundings. Shizuka shows up near the end and returns a journal that holds his exam grade. Nobita's mom apologizes, but is met with Nobita's demands... until she asks him for his grade.

value.title: Lo specchio pubblicitario
value.synopsis: Doraemon and Nobita use a broadcast mirror to advertise a small sweet shop. At first, the advertisement fails to attract customers. But later, a huge crowd gets attracted to the sweet shop.

value.title: Il bambino mostro
value.synopsis: Nobita and Shiuzuka see Gian and Suneo building a model ship in their backyard. Nobita wanted to join, but was rejected because they believed him to be clumsy. Nobita runs back home to build something better or so he claimed. Doraemon left a machine in Nobita's room with an explicit note to not touch and give to the delivery man from the future. The machine said it would create a lifeform, but it had a defect of creating a strong and more powerful race bent on controlling mankind. Doraemon return and somehow managed to end it.

value.title: Il diamante della mamma
value.synopsis: Nobita leaves a photo album on the floor. The book brought nostalgia to Nobita's mother and she recalled a story about a precious diamond ring that was passed down in their family, but was stolen by two boys. Nobita and Doraemon go back in time to stop the robbers. The diamond ring turned out to be plastic and was meant for Nobita's mom to be a lesson.

value.title: Il castello del fantasma (1)
value.synopsis: Nobita's parents consider moving, so he and Doraemon convince them to move to an ancient castle owned by a beautiful woman. When she mysteriously disappears, they must rescue her.

value.title: Il castello del fantasma (2)
value.synopsis: Nobita and Doraemon continue their rescue attempt.

value.title: La polvere Donbura
value.synopsis: Nobita cannot swim so Doraemon uses a powder on him which makes him able to swim through the ground or anything else solid as though it were water, so he can learn to swim.

value.title: L’ombrellino dell’amore
value.synopsis: Doraemon unveils his newest device, the Love Love Parasol.

value.title: Fotomontaggi
value.synopsis: Suneo brags about all the vacation his family has gone on to his friends, but Nobita soon gets annoyed and brags that his family has gone to even more places. Nobita goes home and cries to Doraemon until he pulls out a camera that photoshops Nobita into all kinds of places. When he shows his friends, one of the picture makes everyone realize Nobita's lies, a picture of Nobita on the moon.

value.title: La spesa nel futuro
value.synopsis: Nobita wants a new bike but his parents cannot afford it, then he comes across a catalog from 2087 and orders and gets many things, not realizing that they have to be paid for.

value.title: Crema di lupo
value.synopsis: Doraemon and Nobita argue who is scarier, a werewolf or mom. Doraemon takes out the werewolf cream to transform himself to prove a point. Mom finds the cream and uses it before heading out to an old friend's house. Doraemon, worried, tags along to prevent mom from transforming whenever she looks at a round object.

value.title: Lasciapassare universale
value.synopsis: Doraemon gives Nobita a pass that lets him do whatever he wants. The pass, however, is going to expire at sundown. Nobita sort of aware of the situation takes Shizuka out for a day of fun, going to the nearby kid forbidden coffeehouse and a celebrity's house. The pass expires while they are having fun and Nobita and Shizuka are forced to walk home.

value.title: L’interruttore per dittatori
value.synopsis: Nobita wishes Gian had never existed, so Doraemon lends him the Dictator Switch, which makes people disappear.

value.title: L’ombra di Guglia
value.synopsis: Nobisuke asks Nobita to weed the garden even though it is a hot day. Doraemon uses the Shadow Cutting Scissors to make Nobita's shadow weed the garden for him. Remade in 1996 under the same title.

value.title: Simulatore spaziale
value.synopsis: Nobita wants to be a space pilot so Doraemon brings out a machine where a remote controlled small saucer gives an impression of being on an alien world, even when in Shizuka's bath room when she is taking a bath.

value.title: Un campo di riso
value.synopsis: Nobita and Doraemon both like rice cakes but fight over the last one so Doraemon uses a DIY paddy field to grow much rice and a machine to make many rice cakes but with 259 of them to eat, the two still fight over the odd one.

value.title: Vacanze estive
value.synopsis: Nobita can't wait for a holiday from school so Doraemon gives him a clock which can make the days fly by. Nobita ends up making his vacation fly by as he tries to satisfy everyone.

value.title: Tara la sincera
value.synopsis: Nobita and Doraemon use a gadget to help Nobita's uncle go out with the woman he likes.

value.title: Il muschio vivente
value.synopsis: Suneo's story of a UFO inspires Doraemon to fly a martian spaceship.

value.title: L’uomo spaziale
value.synopsis: Doraemon continues pursuing his dream.

value.title: La luce retrovisiva
value.synopsis: Nobita is doing his schoolwork for once in his life. The project calls for him to learn about the origin of items around his house. Doraemon happy that Nobita is doing his work, willingly pulls out a gadget that reverse items to their origin for 15 minutes.

value.title: Jekyll e Hyde
value.synopsis: Doraemon gives Nobita pills which can change the user's personality for ten minutes.

value.title: Cooperativa gatti
value.synopsis: Nobita takes four cats off of Shizuka's hands as a favor but his mother doesn't want them in the house. Doraemon uses bracelets to control them and the cats become obedient mousers in the neighborhood.

value.title: Il catalogo delle ragazze
value.synopsis: A machine which can predict future girlfriends causes trouble for Nobita when he visits them before they will know him. He realizes he is best off with Shizuka.

value.title: Il teleprendi
value.synopsis: Gian steals Nobita's yoyo so Doraemon gives him a telescope where when you look at something, you can reach there and pick up something from the scene. Or if an immovable object like a tree, you can travel to the scene.

value.title: Pasticcini per cani
value.synopsis: Nobita eats a biscuit used to get rid of dogs. Once they leave home they can't find their way back. Nobita tries not to leave home but does and gets lost.

value.title: La candela del favore
value.synopsis: Hearing that Gian will blacklist the baseball players who did poorly including him, Nobita uses the Y Candle from Doraemon to bribe his mother into returning the baseball bat and glove she had confiscated. Then he uses it to bribe Gian into letting him play.

value.title: L’isola deserta
value.synopsis: Nobita comes home late and gets yelled at by his parents. Nobita runs away from home with some of Doraemon's gadget. Nobita finds life on the island difficult, but can't find a way home until Doraemon finds him. By the time Doraemon finds him, it has been 10 years and Nobita has grown old. Worried that his parents won't accept him, Nobita and Doraemon travel 10 years to the past and use the time cloth to revert Nobita to his younger self.

value.title: Un tasto per studiare
value.synopsis: Nobita wants a different environment to study in so Doraemon uses a machine which can make the surrounding area look like any place in the world. In the desert scene they see a man dying of thirst.

value.title: Lo specchio bugiardo
value.synopsis: Nobita finds a mirror in his room left by Doraemon. Nobita sees how beautiful he looks, but is told by Doraemon that it is a lying mirror. The mirror is able to convince everyone to change their current facial expression to look more 'beautiful'. It has a malicious streak and convinces Nobita he is handsome when he pulls an ugly face.

value.title: La corda prendi tutto
value.synopsis: Suneo comes to return a borrowed umbrella, but Doraemon and Nobita are both too lazy to get up. Doraemon pulls out a rope that lets him retrieve things. Nobita wants to borrow the rope but during Doraemon and Nobita's fight, it gets thrown out the window and into Suneo's hand. Suneo uses the rope to steal and pull practical jokes before escaping and leaving the rope on the ground. Nobita finds the rope and is blamed, but denies that he is able to use the rope. A little girl falls into a nearby ditch, Nobita struggles but still pulls her out with the rope. The girl reveals that it was Suneo that was playing with the rope.

value.title: La casa dell’extraterrestre
value.synopsis: Nobita and his friends make a bet about whether aliens exist by going into a house in the woods that is supposedly alien infested. Nobita returns home and uses Doraemon to help him search the house from far away. Nobita and Doraemon runs away after seeing something, but Gian and Suneo go into the house and explore. It turns out the house was a prop house meant for alien movies.

value.title: La cattiva strada
value.synopsis: Nobita is inspired by a book of Great Men and resolves to do good deeds but they all turn out bad. He gets angry and resolves to do bad things, but Doraemon pulls out a gadget to prevent him and somehow all his bad actions turn out good. Remade in 1990 as "Nobita's Wicked Aspiration."

value.title: The medicine of boy students and girl students
value.synopsis: Nobita's father moans at him because he doesn't like boy's games. Doraemon uses a spray which makes boys behave like girls and girls behave like boys. Nobita doesn't like the result and even less when he finds it has affected his parents too.

value.title: The Absconding Leaf
value.synopsis: A man mistreats his pet dog. The Pengpeng leaf causes the dog to swap places with its owner, giving it a day of freedom while the man is chained up. The dog goes on to play baseball while the man struggles to escape. After spending the day chained up, the man realizes what he's done.

value.title: Memory Hammer
value.synopsis: A man goes around the houses in the neighborhood trying to find out who he is. Doraemon hits him over the head with the forgotten hammer which causes his memories to be projected on a wall.

value.title: La cuffia della risata
value.synopsis: Nobita is so bored he annoys Doraemon into giving him a smiling earphone. When Nobita puts it in his ear, he hears much funny stuff which makes him laugh uncontrollably. This first upsets his mother, then his friends who think he is laughing at them.

value.title: Serpezeta
value.synopsis: Doraemon warns Nobita that Gian will be the one to discover the Tsuchinoko and gain fame for that, so they both travel to the future to bring one Tsuchinoko with them and show off to their friends. The Tsuchinoko sneaks out to Gian, who makes a name for himself as a result.

value.title: Il Tarzan spaziale (1)
value.synopsis: Space Tarzan about prehistoric men and spacemen is Nobita's favorite show but he meets the star and finds it has gone over budget too much and is close to being canceled because of falling viewing figures. He decides to help him by going 150 million years into the past to get some real dinosaurs to replace the poor models they use in the show.

value.title: Il Tarzan spaziale (2)
value.synopsis: After a few narrow escapes, Doraemon and Nobita feed mealie pellets (which make any animal tame) to a load of dinosaurs. Doraemon fixes his time machine to a hut door so when Tai and his producers walk through the door, they are 150 million years ago. The show becomes a success thanks to the "real looking dinosaurs and scenery" which cost nothing.

value.title: Even in the Stomach, in the Acid
value.synopsis: Shizuka is eating peanuts and accidentally swallows her mom's 500,000 yen opal. Nobita and Doraemon use the Suichu Buggy and the Small Light to get into Shizuka's stomach and get the opal out.

value.title: The Dream Channel
value.synopsis: Nobita is unable to sleep. Doraemon lends the Dream Channel to Nobita, which lets him watch other people's dreams, including those of Gian, Suneo and Shizuka while criticizing the plot of each dream.

value.title: Development and Degradation Radiation
value.synopsis: Nobita's father is old fashioned, so Nobita uses Doraemon's Progression-Regression Beam to make things as they would have been in the past or future, then starts on living things with a mouse devolved 200,000,000 years to become a large dinosaur and his father evolved into a future man. Remade as The Progression-Regression Beam in the 2005 series.

value.title: Vacanze alle terme
value.synopsis: Nobita's mother wants to go to the hot springs for a holiday but his father says it is too crowded and hard to get there, so Doraemon sets up 3D projectors around the house which make it look like they are at the hot springs.

value.title: Giangi Superman
value.synopsis: Nobita finds a super cape, but Gian snatches the cape and uses it to become Super Gian, whose only power is being able to fly when summoned by a whistle. This episode was later remade in 1992 in the same series, then remade as Super Gian, Hero of Justice in the 2005 series.

value.title: La giacca in più
value.synopsis: Nobita and Shizuka go on an Over-exaggerating Overcoat adventure.

value.title: Caccia al topo
value.synopsis: Doraemon is even more scared of mice than Nobita's mother is and starts shooting at everything that moves when one turns up in the house. Remade as Only Four More Hours Until the Mice Are Driven Away in the 2005 series.

value.title: Imparerò a nuotare
value.synopsis: Doraemon gets Nobita to learn how to swim using the Just-As-You-Said Pills, and they go diving in the sky.

value.title: Il super cappello
value.synopsis: Nobita wants to impress Shizuka at her birthday. Therefore, Doraemon takes out the Esper Hat, a tool of ESP training. This episode would later be remade in 1995 as "Esper Cap," and both would later be remade in the 2005 series.

value.title: Il giocattolo umano
value.synopsis: Gian is in charge of baseball practice but is a tyrant so Nobita uses a remote control box on Gian which controls him like a robot.

value.title: Magnify Bad Habits Gas
value.synopsis: Annoyed by everyone's bad habits, Nobita asked for a gadget. Doraemon pulls out a gadget called Magnify Bad Habits Gas that can turn bad habits into something weird, such as making Nobita's booger turn into a large pink, soft, bouncy ball when he picks his nose.

value.title: L’angelo custode
value.synopsis: Doraemon sees that Nobita is bad at making simple decisions, so he gives him a Guidance Angel to help him out.

value.title: La macchina vendicatrice
value.synopsis: After Gian tricks Nobita into running away from a worm, something he cannot stand, Doraemon uses a machine to first make Gian scared of puppies, then scared of Nobita.

value.title: Il cucciolo
value.synopsis: Nobita hatches a 22nd-century egg and out comes a small typhoon, which he treats as a pet. Then Japan suffers a major typhoon which is heading towards their house which has a loose roof and the little typhoon goes out to try and stop it.

value.title: Comandante e… comandati
value.synopsis: Nobita uses Rank Badges to order his parents around. Remade as Stand to Sergeant Nobita's Attention! in the 2005 series.

value.title: La doccia che inganna
value.synopsis: To avoid getting hit by Gian, Nobita uses a shower which makes it look like he is several feet away from his actual position, which allows him to kick Gian without retaliation.

value.title: Il cappello fa ciò che vuoi
Una giornata fortunata
value.synopsis: Nobita who was born on August 7 checks his astrology in a comic and thinks he is due a good week. Doraemon gives him a small mechanical bug which if you predict something, it can come true. The problem is that Nobita is a pessimist who thinks the worst, and it was last week's comic he was using.

value.title: La politica di Guglia
value.synopsis: Doraemon presents the Portable National Diet, a tool that manipulates the legislation of the country that the user lives in. To legislate, the user must write a law, then send the envelope to the council, and then the law will be legislated.

value.title: La medicina della velocità
value.synopsis: Doraemon believes Nobita is too slow and brings out the Fast and Slow Pills, and plans to use Fast on Nobita to speed him up. However, Nobita wants Doraemon to try it himself, so he takes the pills.

value.title: La mappa radar
value.synopsis: Remade as Tracing With the Tracer Badge in the 2005 series.

value.title: Papà di sé stesso
value.synopsis: Nobita time travels and meets his future self.

value.title: Le commissioni di Guglia
value.synopsis: Doraemon introduces the Vending Time Machine, which can sell anything throughout time. Remade as Shopping Across the Ages in the 2005 series.

value.title: A World Where You Don't Need Money
Abekonbe
value.synopsis: Doraemon introduces the Abekonbe, an arrow that makes everything work in the opposite way.

value.title: La gomma magica
value.synopsis: When Gian and Suneo frame Nobita for breaking a man's window, Doraemon gives Nobita the Dairi Gum to make Gian and Suneo confess their mistake.

value.title: L’orologio programmatore
value.synopsis: Doraemon helps Nobita make a schedule, but ends up giving HIMSELF a schedule instead and Nobita takes advantage of this.

value.title: Uno strano autore
value.synopsis: Funyako is sick so Doraemon takes over to draw the comic.

value.title: Il cane resuscitato
value.synopsis: Doraemon and Nobita go back to the night before Shizuka's pet dog died and try to prevent his death.

value.title: La teoria di Guglia
value.synopsis: Because of Nobita's research, Doraemon decides to take him to the past. However, they get stranded on an island and must find a way to return to the present.

value.title: Il cannone
value.synopsis: Doraemon introduces the Anywhere Cannon. Its user can blast off to wherever they want to go.

value.title: Mangime pericoloso
value.synopsis: Nobita is jealous of Suneo's carp pond so Doraemon gives him some magic food which when fish eat it, they can swim through air like it is water and they are tame. Suneo is jealous of Nobita's flying fish so steals the food and gets his sea captain uncle to use it on fish out at sea. A box arrives for Suneo and when opened is full of deep sea flying fish monsters.

value.title: Sherlock Holmes Set
value.synopsis: Using the Sherlock Holmes Set, Nobita tries solving two cases with Doraemon, yet ends up realizing both of cases are connected as he unknowingly is the causer of both.

value.title: Il cappello di Pollicino
value.synopsis: This episode is based on a Japanese fairy tale called Issun-bōshi.

value.title: La sfilata di moda
value.synopsis: Gian and Suneo get hold of one of Doraemon's devices.

value.title: Dream Walker
value.synopsis: After seeing Doraemon wearing a special gadget called the Dream Walker, Nobita wears it and go on an adventure.

value.title: Il cuscino dei sogni
value.synopsis: After a good dream, Doraemon gives Nobita The Reality Pillow.

value.title: Lighter Play
value.synopsis: Doraemon introduces to Nobita the Scenario Lighter that allows the cast to enact a scene as if they were in a play.

value.title: L'allevamento di dolci
value.synopsis: Doraemon shows Nobita a farm full of sweet snacks.

value.title: Visi cancellati
value.synopsis: When Nobita becomes depressed over his looks, Doraemon shows him a gadget that erases a person's facial features and enables him to draw on an entirely new face.

value.title: Gli ombrelli
value.synopsis: On a rainy day, Doraemon utilizes a variety of strange umbrellas.

value.title: Il giornaletto del futuro
value.synopsis: Nobita wants to read the comic books of the 22nd century.

value.title: La vita è dura
value.synopsis: Doraemon introduces the Hardship Miso. One taste of this miso, and anything one does will end up being hard and painful. Remade in 1992 under the same title.

value.title: La palestra in casa
value.synopsis: Doraemon is sick of Nobita being lazy so he turns the house into an athletic house. However while Doraemon was turning on the machine, Nobita went outside.

value.title: Il biglietto della lotteria
value.synopsis: Dad wastes money in the lottery, so Doraemon and Nobita try to get the ticket of the win number using the time machine.

value.title: Una montagna di pasticcini
value.synopsis: Nobita doesn't want to lose his chestnut bun, so he takes out the Multiplication Liquid that multiplies anything every five minutes with a drop

value.title: Missili fatti in casa
value.synopsis: Nobita makes a missile in order to take revenge on Gian.

value.title: Le canzoni di Giangi
value.synopsis: Doraemon takes out the Sonic Oscillation Terror Machine, which converts high decibel sounds into a sound wave that rids the house of pests. Nobita decides to use Gian's terrible singing and invites him over to his house to sing. Nobita later begins an exterminating company and invites Gian over to their classmates' houses to get rid of the pests with Gian's destructive voice.
